title: Admin API
summary: Everything an administrator does on the Versioniq page can also be done by a script or another system.

title: App Discovery
summary: A multi-source search aggregator that lets admins find Nextcloud apps to install across the App Store, their PAT-visible private GitHub repos, and (opt-in) public GitHub topic search.

title: Artifact Cache
summary: Make rollback link-rot-proof: verified archives are retained locally after successful installs and used as a same-version fallback when the upstream source can no longer deliver.

title: Audit Trail
summary: The audit trail records every version operation Versioniq performs.

title: Auto-Update Policies
summary: Turn Versioniq from a repair tool into bounded, observable update automation: per-app semver-level policies executed nightly through the app's own verified installer path, honoring pins, constrained to a maintenance window, defaulting to off, and reporting every action.

title: Changelog Visibility
summary: Admins choosing a version to install.

title: CLI Commands
summary: Expose Versioniq's version listing and version-specific install through occ, so provisioning scripts, CI pipelines, and Docker image builds can reproduce exact app versions.

title: External Sources
summary: External sources allow Versioniq to install Nextcloud apps from origins outside the Nextcloud App Store.

title: PAT Management
summary: Encrypted Personal Access Token storage for the Versioniq app, so admins can install apps from private GitHub repositories.

title: Pending Updates
summary: An admin sees on one screen which apps run which version, which have a newer one, and which fell behind the agreed limit.

title: Version Management
summary: Version management is the core capability of Versioniq.

title: Version Pinning
summary: Pinning holds an installed app at a chosen version.
